text: Warm-up calculator (PRO badge) opens paywall: monthly CA$3.99, yearly CA$31.99 (save 33%), lifetime CA$104.99; dismiss via X or 暂不. Pro appears NOT active despite trial claim
keypad + key increments weight by 2.5 kg (barbell)
add-set row shows previous set's values as grey placeholders; tapping check accepts them (2 taps for a repeat set)
Workout starts immediately on 开始空白锻炼: timer running, empty workout, no popup
Bench added with 1 empty set (0/0 grey placeholders), 之前的锻炼 shows '-' (no history). No prefill.

Warm-up: tap set badge -> sheet 选择组类型 -> 热身组 (badge W). App keypad: arrow on weight jumps to reps; keypad's bottom-right key on reps is a green check that marks the set done and closes keypad. Rest timer default Off -> no popup after first check. Warm-up counted in 训练量 400kg
添加组 after warm-up creates a normal set (not W) with previous set's 40/10 as grey placeholders
After adding exercise the list auto-scrolls so new card is visible

dip search: 双杠臂屈伸（负重） is 6th result, hidden behind system keyboard; swipe list to dismiss keyboard. Bodyweight variant 双杠臂屈伸 has reps only; weighted variant has +KG column. Used weighted variant with +KG 0 for BW sets
Save screen: title (empty), duration/volume 9067.5kg/20 sets, add photo/video, description, date, gym, 可见性 default 所有人 (public). Changing visibility to private

hit.label: desc=私密, 将此锻炼保持私有，仅对你可见，供个人使用。

text: Visibility sheet does not close on selection; back key to close. 3 of the finish actions (open visibility, 私密, back) are only for privacy
After save: celebration/share screen 好样的! 第1次锻炼 with share cards (Instagram, more, copy text, download); dismiss with 完成

Explore: 首页 card ⋮ menu = 分享锻炼/保存为计划/复制锻炼/编辑锻炼/删除锻炼. 复制锻炼 starts workout with all 5 exercises x 4 sets prefilled (white values, W kept, 之前的锻炼 column). Adding single bench (with history) to blank workout pre-creates 4 sets with last numbers as grey placeholders incl. W; check accepts them
T3: all exercises pre-added by 复制锻炼 so no T3-En-add phases; values prefilled as real values (white) from last workout
Checking a set near the bottom auto-scrolls the list by about one row to keep the next set in view (caused a mis-tap once; voided)
Save screen again defaults 可见性=所有人 even though last workout was saved private (no memory of choice); 9067.5kg / 20 sets matches T1

hit.label: desc=私密, 将此锻炼保持私有，仅对你可见，供个人使用。

text: After 2nd save, home feed shows banner 与健身房朋友一起玩Hevy更有趣 (与朋友联系 / 忽略)
Edit done set: tap weight (value preselected, keypad opens), + key adds 2.5 -> 62.5, hide-keypad key. Set stays checked, volume updates
Delete set: swipe row left -> red 删除 -> tap. No confirmation, no undo toast/button anywhere (no undo in Hevy). Edited 62.5 set badge turns into a PR medal icon (live PR)
After reorder 完成, view stays at bottom; moved exercise is at top -> needed scrolling back up (4 swipes, maybe 2 would do)
删除运动 via card ⋮: no confirmation (exercise had no done sets)
Home+relaunch: workout screen intact, timer kept running (6min12s), edits retained
Force-stop + relaunch: opens on 首页 with floating in-progress bar (锻炼 6min27s, current exercise, expand ^ and trash). Expanding shows everything intact incl. timer
Last session numbers already visible inline in 之前的锻炼 column (0 taps)
Exercise detail: tabs 总结/历史记录/怎么做/排行榜; chart includes in-progress value; chips 最重的重量/1RM(Epley-like 77.16)/最佳...; range 最近3个月 dropdown; 个人纪录 list
Library opens with 近期的训练 list where bench is first: search was optional (could skip 2 actions). 1RM 74.07 from saved workouts. 历史记录 tab lists past sessions with set lines
Pro NOT active in app: chart ranges 年/所有时间 open paywall '无限图表历史记录, 免费版限制: 3 个月'. Trial claimed by user is not reflected
Paywall feature list: 无限图表历史记录(免费3个月), 无限训练计划, Hevy Trainer, 无限自定义训练动作, 高级统计, 跟踪所有测量数据, 热身计算器, 支持我们的小团队

T8 (started from 个人资料 tab): gear -> scroll -> 导出和导入数据 -> 导出数据 -> 导出锻炼 -> system share sheet workout_data.csv. CSV only, free, no Pro badge. Separate 导出测量结果. Note: exported data cannot be re-imported into Hevy
Measurements: free = 体重 + 腰围 only; 体脂/去脂/颈/肩/胸/二头/前臂... locked (PRO). Progress photo allowed. System numeric keyboard. Recorded 75 kg on 10/26 (onboarding had 85 kg on 10/25)
Routine limit verified: 5th routine -> sheet 'Free accounts have a limit of 4 routines. Upgrade to Hevy Pro to create unlimited routines.' (继续/暂不)
WARNING: chained tap accidentally pressed 接受并继续 on the Hevy Trainer medical disclaimer (健康条款和政策) — unintended; must be reported. Did not save the plan.
Rest timer when set per exercise: non-blocking bottom bar (-15 / 00:43 / +15 / 跳过) after ✓, no modal

Custom exercises: free limit shown '自定义训练 (1/7)' + 解锁更多. Create form: media, name, equipment (无/杠铃/杠铃片/壶铃/器械/悬挂带/哑铃/阻力带/...), primary muscle, other muscles, type (重量和次数/徒手次数/负重徒手+Kg/辅助徒手-Kg/时长/持续时间与重量/距离和时长/...)
Per-exercise weight unit (默认/公斤/磅) in exercise ⋮ menu
Volume of saved workout changed 9067.5 -> 8687.5 kg after I logged bodyweight 75 (was 85): weighted-dip volume = (latest bodyweight + added) x reps, recomputed retroactively (38 reps x 10 kg = 380)
